text: {"table": {"name": "customers", "purpose": "Customer master table: one row per customer, with a segment code and preferred billing currency. Referenced by transactions_1k (customer id) and yearmonth (likely a customer-period table keyed by customer)."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "customer_id", "description": "Primary key; unique customer identifier (integer). Exact expansion of the acronyms is not certain.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_003": {"role": "code", "name": "currency", "description": "Customer's billing currency: CZK (Czech koruna, 30459) or EUR (2002).", "status": "resolved"}}}
